K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills.context_zh: 在终端执行，按安装器提示选择所需技能及宿主；安装技能文件不会安装科学计算依赖。
K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills.context_en: Run in a terminal and choose the required skills and host; installing skill files does not install scientific dependencies.

Imbad0202/academic-research-skills.context_zh: 在Claude Code会话内依次执行；安装后用/ars-plan或/ars-lit-review验证。
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills.context_en: Run both commands in a Claude Code session; verify with /ars-plan or /ars-lit-review.

Yuan1z0825/nature-skills.command: npx skills add Yuan1z0825/nature-skills --agent codex --skill nature-figure --yes --copy
Yuan1z0825/nature-skills.context_zh: 在终端为当前项目的Codex仅安装nature-figure；此命令不安装完整技能集或Python/R/MCP依赖。
Yuan1z0825/nature-skills.context_en: Run in a terminal to install only nature-figure for Codex in the current project; this does not install the full collection or Python/R/MCP dependencies.

zsyggg/paper-craft-skills.context_zh: 在终端执行，按提示选择安装目标
zsyggg/paper-craft-skills.context_en: Run in a terminal and choose installation targets

openags/paper-search-mcp.command:
uv tool install paper-search-mcp
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills/paper-search
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openags/paper-search-mcp/main/claude-code/SKILL.md \
  -o ~/.claude/skills/paper-search/SKILL.md
openags/paper-search-mcp.context_zh: 在终端按官方 Claude Code Skill 路线先安装 CLI，再下载 Skill 到用户级 ~/.claude/skills/paper-search；下一次启动 Claude Code 生效。此路线不需要 MCP 配置；MCP 客户端另按官方其他安装方法。
openags/paper-search-mcp.context_en: In a terminal, follow the Claude Code skill path: install the CLI, then download the skill into the user-level ~/.claude/skills/paper-search directory. It activates on the next Claude Code start. This route needs no MCP configuration; MCP clients use the other documented methods.

wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-.context_zh: 按官方步骤克隆到稳定路径，再为目标项目安装；Claude Code、Codex和Windows路线不同，审阅桥接需单独配置。
wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-.context_en: Follow the official steps to clone to a stable location and install into the target project; Claude Code, Codex and Windows use different routes, and the reviewer bridge requires separate setup.

Orchestra-Research/AI-Research-SKILLs.context_zh: 在终端启动交互安装器，选择全部、快速入门、类别或单个技能；技能放在~/.orchestra/skills并链接至宿主，Windows回退为复制。
Orchestra-Research/AI-Research-SKILLs.context_en: Run the interactive installer in a terminal; choose all, quickstart, categories or individual skills. Files go to ~/.orchestra/skills with host symlinks and a copy fallback on Windows.

Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex.command:
codex plugin marketplace add Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex --ref main
codex plugin add ars-codex@ars-codex
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex.context_zh: 在终端使用Codex CLI添加市场并安装插件；安装后开启新的Codex会话，调用$academic-research-suite。
Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex.context_en: Use Codex CLI in a terminal to add the marketplace and install the plugin; open a new Codex conversation and invoke $academic-research-suite.

HKUSTDial/Supervisor-Skills.context_zh: 将官方Quick Start中的安装提示词发给Claude Code、Cursor或Codex等AI助手，再按所选技能文档操作；README未提供可直接复制的终端安装命令。
HKUSTDial/Supervisor-Skills.context_en: Send the Quick Start installation prompt to an AI assistant such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, then follow the selected skill documentation; README provides no terminal installation command.

hoochanlon/hamuleite.context_zh: 这是学术、教育与金融资源导航库；按目录浏览资料或所链接工具，未提供统一技能包安装步骤。
hoochanlon/hamuleite.context_en: This is a directory of academic, educational and financial resources; browse its folders and linked tools. No unified skill-package installation is documented.

ChenLiu-1996/figures4papers.context_zh: 无需安装：在AI编码助手打开仓库并在提示词中引用scientific-figure-making/SKILL.md及references。也可从仓库根目录按官方表格为Cursor/Claude Code/Codex建立软链接，之后刷新技能列表。
ChenLiu-1996/figures4papers.context_en: No-install route: open the repository in an AI coding agent and reference scientific-figure-making/SKILL.md and references. Alternatively, follow the host-specific symlink table from the repository root and refresh the agent’s skill list.

Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.context_zh: 先取得仓库并在仓库根目录操作；按Codex、Claude Code全局/项目或Gemini选择对应复制步骤。Codex路线依赖已正确配置的CODEX_HOME，故保留官方分步说明。
Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.context_en: Obtain the repository and work from its root, then choose the copy steps for Codex, Claude Code global/project or Gemini. The Codex route assumes CODEX_HOME is configured, so follow the official step-by-step instructions.

jihe520/MathModelAgent.context_zh: 在终端执行官方 Skills 安装命令；供现有 Claude Code / Codex 使用。它安装技能，不部署 Web 应用。桌面版另从 Releases 安装，已内置 Claude Code 和技能。
jihe520/MathModelAgent.context_en: Run the official skills installer in a terminal for an existing Claude Code / Codex host. This installs skills; it does not deploy the web app. The separate desktop release bundles Claude Code and skills.

zLanqing/codex-claude-academic-skills.context_zh: 按官方跨平台安装章节把三个技能目录复制到 Claude Code / Codex 全局目录，或当前项目的 .claude/skills / .codex/skills。原文克隆和插件示例仍含“你的用户名”及不同仓库名占位符，不提供可复制的一键命令。
zLanqing/codex-claude-academic-skills.context_en: Follow the cross-platform section to copy the three skill folders into the Claude Code / Codex global skill directory or the project’s .claude/skills / .codex/skills. Clone and plugin examples contain a username placeholder and a different repository name, so no one-click command is supplied.

brycewang-stanford/Auto-Empirical-Resear.command:
claude plugin marketplace add brycewang-stanford/Auto-Empirical-Research-Skills
claude plugin install aer-skills@auto-empirical-research-skills
brycewang-stanford/Auto-Empirical-Resear.context_zh: 在终端安装官方 aer-skills 首方插件栈（9 个论文流程技能），随后在 Claude Code 中 /reload-plugins 或重启。该命令不安装整个资料库；其他 Python/Stata/R 栈和 Codex 整库路由导入见完整安装文档。
brycewang-stanford/Auto-Empirical-Resear.context_en: Run in a shell to install the first-party aer-skills stack (nine manuscript skills), then /reload-plugins or restart Claude Code. These commands do not install the entire catalog; see INSTALL.md for other Python/Stata/R stacks and Codex catalog-router import.

Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.command:
codex plugin marketplace add Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skill
codex plugin add anti-defensive-writing@adkid-zephyr-writing
Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.context_zh: 在支持插件命令的 Codex 终端添加本仓库 marketplace 并安装插件；新对话选择 Anti-Defensive Writing。也可按 README 复制 Skill 目录或直接粘贴提示词。
Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.context_en: In a Codex terminal supporting plugin commands, add this repository’s marketplace and plugin, then select Anti-Defensive Writing in a new conversation. The README also supports copying a skill directory or pasting the prompt.

Norman-bury/research-writing-skill.context_zh: 按 Codex 安装文档克隆到 ~/.codex/research-writing-skill，再将 skills 连接到 ~/.agents/skills/research-writing，重启 Codex 并检查链接。Windows 有单独 PowerShell 目录连接步骤；其他平台见 README。
Norman-bury/research-writing-skill.context_en: Follow the Codex guide to clone into ~/.codex/research-writing-skill, link skills into ~/.agents/skills/research-writing, restart Codex, and verify the link. Windows has a separate PowerShell junction procedure; see README for other hosts.

yilewang/llm-for-zotero.context_zh: 从官方 Releases 下载 .xpi，在 Zotero 的 Tools → Add-ons → Install Add-on From File 中安装，重启并在首选项配置模型供应商及连接测试。按所选后端完成额外配置。
yilewang/llm-for-zotero.context_en: Download the .xpi from official Releases, install through Zotero Tools → Add-ons → Install Add-on From File, restart, then configure and test a provider in preferences. Complete the additional setup for the chosen backend.

OpenNSWM-Lab/FAROS.context_zh: 按快速开始分别在 backend 和 frontend 安装并启动服务，再在设置页配置和测试模型。运行生成代码、计算节点部署、论文编译需继续完成部署指南相应依赖。
OpenNSWM-Lab/FAROS.context_en: Follow Quick Start to install/start backend and frontend separately, then configure and test a model in settings. Generated-code execution, compute-node deployment and paper compilation require the corresponding deployment-guide setup.

huangwb8/ChineseResearchLaTeX.context_zh: 按官方 Skills 安装与更新指南选择自然语言安装或系统对应的 Python 引导安装；LaTeX 公共包安装和模板编译是另外的步骤，不把安装整个公共包当作 Skills 安装。
huangwb8/ChineseResearchLaTeX.context_en: Use the official skills installation/update guide to choose natural-language installation or the OS-specific Python bootstrap. Installing shared LaTeX packages and compiling templates are separate steps, not the same as skills installation.

LigphiDonk/academic-figure-generator.context_zh: 在终端执行官方 npx skills 命令安装 academic-figure-prompt 技能，供 AI 编程助手生成论文配图提示词；完整 Web 平台部署另按快速开始配置，不由此命令完成。
LigphiDonk/academic-figure-generator.context_en: Run the documented npx skills command in a terminal to install academic-figure-prompt for an AI coding assistant. It generates paper-figure prompts; the full web platform requires the separate Quick Start deployment.
